name: Chicken Caesar Wrap
instructions: Season chicken with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through.
Toss romaine with Caesar dressing and parmesan.
Lay tortilla flat. Add salad, chicken, and croutons down the center.
Fold sides in and roll tightly. Slice in half diagonally.

substitutions.dairy_free: Use dairy-free Caesar dressing and skip parmesan.
substitutions.gluten_free: Use gluten-free wrap and skip croutons.
substitutions.low_carb: Serve as a salad bowl instead of a wrap.
